Title: [LSJ] king of the mountain and agravated damage

Messages.Author: ThE_OnLy_VipeR
Messages.Body:
if i play a king of the mountain in superior and the oposing vampire
try to strike me with and agravated strike, the damage of the strike
returns to him agravated or normal?

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:



King of the Mountain [FN:C2]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Fortitude
[for] Prevent all damage from the opposing minion's
strike. If the strike was made with a melee weapon,
that weapon is destroyed.
[FOR] Play after range is determined and before strikes
are chosen. If the opposing minion inflicts damage with
a hand strike this round (even if the damage is prevented),
he or she takes an equal amount of damage during strike
resolution as well.

Opponent takes normal damage, because he or she takes
damage equal to the _amount_ he inflicted (disregarding
other damage characteristics). The source of damage for
him or her is the King of the Mountain card, which does
not explicitly state that it inflicts anything but
normal damage.

--
Bye,

Daneel
